headline: Lawmakers eye defense bill to extend FISA Section 702
pages: Weeks before the end of the legislative session, some members of Congress are trying to reauthorize Section 702 of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act, possibly by attaching it to the must-pass National Defense Authorization Act. Sen. Mike Rounds said there is not time to work on FISA alone, but attaching it to the defense bill could get it done. Section 702 allows warrantless surveillance of certain foreigners' communications on national security grounds, and Congress revisits it every few years. An earlier effort failed over the summer, despite pressure from President Trump, in part because leadership barred amendments to limit its scope. The authority has not technically lapsed.
Supporters are rushing to act before Democrats take control of Congress. Source: The Verge.
